exposure: Thickness of the subcutaneous space within the anterior abdomen at the midtrimester fetal anatomical survey
finding: Midtrimester subcutaneous thickness was not associated with an increased risk of cesarean wound complications, although vertical skin incision, stapled wound closure, and classical hysterotomy were.
mod_finding: Vertical skin incisions during cesarean delivery were associated with wound complications, while mid-trimester subcutaneous thickness was not.
